about.title: CiteBrand
about.text: CiteBrand is the diagnostic tool for AI search visibility.
about.quote: The diagnostic tool for AI search visibility.

products.title: AI platform diagnostics
products.text: CiteBrand gives actionable diagnostics for visibility in ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity.
products.quote: Get actionable diagnostics for ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity visibility.

products.title: Source Gap Analysis
products.text: Source Gap Analysis finds the exact URLs where competitors are cited but you are not.
products.quote: Source Gap Analysis Find the exact URLs where competitors are cited but you're not.

products.title: Sentiment Diagnostics
products.text: Sentiment Diagnostics shows why LLMs think your pricing is "expensive" or your UX is "complex", with specific fixes.
products.quote: Sentiment Diagnostics Discover why LLMs think your pricing is "expensive" or UX is "complex". Get specific fixes.

products.title: Intent Mismatch Detection
products.text: Intent Mismatch Detection shows the content format that wins when AI wants a different format than you have.
products.quote: Intent Mismatch Detection AI wants comparison tables but you have blog posts? We show the content format that wins.

products.title: Knowledge Graph Check
products.text: Knowledge Graph Check checks whether you are in Wikidata, Google Knowledge Graph and other sources LLMs trust.
products.quote: Knowledge Graph Check Are you in Wikidata? Google Knowledge Graph? We check all sources LLMs trust.

products.title: Hallucination Detection
products.text: Hallucination Detection uses your uploaded truth files to find every time an LLM gets your pricing, features, or facts wrong.
products.quote: Hallucination Detection Upload your truth files. We find every time an LLM gets your pricing, features, or facts wrong.

products.title: Competitor Tracking
products.text: Competitor Tracking shows exactly where competitors appear and you don't.
products.quote: Competitor Tracking See exactly where competitors appear and you don't.

products.title: Prioritized action list
products.text: CiteBrand gives a prioritized list of specific URLs, content, and actions to take.

products.title: Diagnostics scan
